Definition: Zabdi, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zabdi is named 6 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Joshua 7:1; 1 Chronicles 8:19; Nehemiah 11:17. In Joshua 7:1 we read, "But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Nehemiah 11:17 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Zabdi is a name the Bible did not forget, and I believe God forgets no one. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
RelatedPeople: Zabdi, Father of Carmi; Zabdi, Son of Shimhi; Zabdi, Son of Asaph
